additional_info.subject: RE: ID0456225-DC/Si-D/AE- [MP/R8 170002423] Reboot Issue CRM:02832000630
additional_info.body:
Dear Franciso,
I hope you are doing well.
I have tried rebooting the charger by pressing F12 and also from the grid level. From the LED indication, it seems that the charger is continuously rebooting by itself.
However, since the display is damaged, I’m unable to see at which point or percentage it gets stuck.
Kindly arrange for someone from the regional team to visit the site and resolve the issue as soon as possible.
Regards,
Nadeem
